name: HeadGas
definition: A model for real-time animatable 3D head reconstruction and animation that extends 3D Gaussian Splatting with a base of learnable latent features, linearly blended with low-dimensional parameters from parametric head models (3DMM) to obtain expression-dependent color and opacity values.
summary: HeadGas is a real-time animatable 3D head reconstruction method that blends latent features with expression weights to predict appearance, avoiding complex 3D motion optimization.
